encoder.diagram:
flowchart TB
  X["입력 x"] --> ENC["인코더 q(z∣x)"]
  ENC --> MU["평균 μ"]
  ENC --> SG["분산 σ²"]
  MU --> Z["재매개변수화 z = μ + σ·ε"]
  SG --> Z
  EPS["ε ~ N(0, I)"] --> Z
  Z --> DEC["디코더 p(x∣z)"]
  DEC --> XH["재구성 x̂"]
  ENC -.->|"KL 정규화"| KL["사전분포 p(z) = N(0, I)에 근접"]
  XH -.->|"재구성 항"| L["ELBO = 재구성 − KL 최대화"]
  KL -.-> L
encoder.pseudocode:
def encode(x, enc):
    mu, log_var = enc(x)  # 확률적 인코더: 분포 파라미터
    eps = normal_like(mu)  # ε ~ N(0, I)
    z = mu + exp(0.5 * log_var) * eps  # 재매개변수화
    return z, mu, log_var

def vae_loss(x, enc, dec):
    z, mu, log_var = encode(x, enc)
    x_hat = dec(z)
    recon = sum((a - b) ** 2 for a, b in zip(x, x_hat))
    # KL(N(μ, σ²) ‖ N(0, I)) 해석해
    kl = -0.5 * sum(1 + lv - m * m - exp(lv)
                    for m, lv in zip(mu, log_var))
    return recon + kl  # -ELBO (상수 제외), 최소화

ensemble-learning.pseudocode:
def bagging_fit(X, y, make_model, n_models):
    models = []
    for _ in range(n_models):
        # 부트스트랩: 같은 크기로 복원 추출
        idx = [randrange(len(X)) for _ in range(len(X))]
        m = make_model()
        m.fit([X[i] for i in idx], [y[i] for i in idx])
        models.append(m)
    return models

def bagging_predict(models, x):
    votes = [m.predict(x) for m in models]
    return max(set(votes), key=votes.count)  # 다수결 투표

entropy.pseudocode:
def entropy(labels):
    n, h = len(labels), 0.0
    for c in set(labels):
        p = labels.count(c) / n
        h -= p * log2(p)  # H = −Σ p·log₂p
    return h

def info_gain(parent, children):  # children: 분할된 레이블들
    n = len(parent)
    after = sum(len(ch) / n * entropy(ch)
                for ch in children)  # 가중평균 엔트로피
    return entropy(parent) - after  # 분할 전 − 분할 후

# 예: info_gain(['+']*5 + ['-']*5,
#               [['+']*4, ['+'] + ['-']*5]) ≈ 0.61
